tldr:
The causal conditional log upper-quantile ratio has a proved finite minimax absolute-risk and honest connected-interval-length frontier on the entire two-layer class \(\mathcal M_\rho\): both orders are
\[
\frac{p\,n^{-\rho/(2\rho+2)}+x_0 n^{-\rho/(2\rho+1)}}{p+x_0}.
\]
The restored model-sanity proof supplies nonemptiness, causal completion, unique nuisance representation, and identification at the zero-mass face by the observed law's affine continuation. Total procedures based on original-record counts attain the frontier with explicit finite constants, and same-class original-record alternatives give lower bounds for every randomized procedure. Known powers yield no logarithmic loss as \(p\) becomes arbitrarily small. The companion interior-validity result concerns this note's count-based slope-only procedure and separates tail composition, optimal precision, and omission-bias boundaries. Conditional potential-outcome wage-tail comparisons are a prospective consumer of this stylized benchmark.
